title: Blind navigator · Level 1: A square
brief: A square, counter-clockwise, back to the start: its side, 1500-2000 mm, is drawn for each run. tour.json holds the drawn side, a number in mm (until P0c-2s's square tour writes the four corners as [x, y] in the start frame); practice runs without it, so practise with a side of 1700. A run scores only if the robot's centre enters a circle of radius 250 mm around each corner (s, 0), (s, s), (0, s) of the square of side s, measured from the nominal start (300, 300), in that order (the return to the start is not one); otherwise it scores 0 and does not finish. Par score 85. Write your own estimate as track.csv after the motors stop: one row t_ms,x_mm,y_mm at least every 500 ms from Run to the program's end (the sensor's own period: the IMU on 8 takes 500 ms to start, so keep your first row as soon as IMU(8) returns), in the start frame (x ahead at the start, y to its left, mm), with an optional fourth column th_deg (your heading estimate, shown as its RMS error, unscored); t_ms must rise row by row. The course compares it with the true position of the robot's centre at each row's t_ms. The level fixes the robot: the class robot with an IMU on I2C 8; its real axle track is drawn for each run near the 178 mm your program assumes (the hidden error). The robot starts within 20 mm and 3 degrees of (300, 300) facing +x. The run ends when the program ends, at 120 s at the latest. Per run: 60 x max(0, 1 - e_end / 200) (e_end: the true end to your true start) + 40 x max(0, 1 - e_track / 100) (e_track: the RMS distance of your estimate from the truth; 0 unless track.csv covers the run with no gap over 500 ms). Pass: a mean of at least 60 over 10 runs, and at least 8 runs that drive the tour, end within 200 mm and write track.csv.

score.run: round(if(visitedInOrder == 3, 60 * max(0, 1 - hypot(endX - startX, endY - startY) / 200) + if(repCovered, 40 * max(0, 1 - repRms_xy / 100), 0), 0), 1)

complete.value: count(r in runs: r.visitedInOrder == 3 & r.repCovered & hypot(r.endX - r.startX, r.endY - r.startY) <= 200)
